subject: Onsite to Async Request — Flight Diversion (Oct 20)
messages:
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@example.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Day-of — Flight diverted, need options

Hi Naomi,

I'm on my way to the office for this afternoon's onsite loop but just got a notification: my flight was diverted and the airline isn't certain when I'll land. I'm really sorry — I know this is late notice.

If it's at all possible, could we either (A) switch today's onsite to an asynchronous coding exercise I can submit within 24 hours, plus a short 20–30 min sync with the hiring manager tomorrow, or (B) push the onsite to next week? I'm flexible and want to make this as low-friction as possible for the interviewers.

I've attached my resume in case you need it here.

Thank you for understanding — I appreciate any option that helps keep the loop moving.

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Product Engineer
NoraHealth

Attachment: aisha_kapoor_resume.pdf (application/pdf, 152 KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: aisha.kapoor@example.com
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Day-of — Flight diverted, need options

Marissa, Jordan — fyi, Aisha's flight diverted (see below). She asks to either convert today's onsite to an async coding submission + short sync, or reschedule.

Options I'd like your input on:
- Async coding + 24h window for submission, followed by a 20–30 min sync with hiring manager (preferred by candidate).
- Reschedule full onsite next week (tight calendar for Jordan).

If we go async, we should:
1) Send the same coding task we use for take-home interviews (lightweight, 90-120min expected work).
2) Give 24 hours for submission.
3) Replace the 90-min deep-dive onsite slot with a 30-min sync for behavioral + clarifying questions.

Attachments: candidate_calendar_invite.ics (original onsite slot)

Can you both confirm availability for a 30-min sync tomorrow between 10:30–12:30 PT if she submits tonight, or propose an alternate window? If we need to reschedule, Marissa will own new invites.

Thanks — Naomi
Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi. Aisha, sorry to hear about the flight — totally understandable.

I'm OK with the async + short sync plan. I can send the standard take-home coding brief (we'll use the "service-mesh" mini-assignment) with instructions and a 24-hour window. If it's helpful, I can also provide an optional 60-minute recorded coding session (candidate-led screen recording) as an alternative to the written submission.

Jordan, can you confirm whether you can do a 30-min sync tomorrow morning between 11:00–12:00 PT? If not, please propose a time and/or a backup interviewer.

I'll draft the note to Aisha and include links to the assignment and the submission form.

—Marissa

- Jordan will do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 11:30 PT (confirmed). If that becomes impossible, we'll use Priya as backup.
- We'll skip the full-day onsite; if anything in the hiring loop needs to be scheduled after review, Marissa will coordinate.

Action items: Marissa — please send the brief and the submission link to Aisha and update the HubSpot deal (HP-4821) with "async accepted — flight diversion". Aisha — please confirm you received the brief when it arrives.
